title: Bloom Energy vs. Oklo: Which AI-Power Stock Is the Smarter Buy Now?
excerpt: Both energy stocks are attracting significant attention, but one is clearly the better buy.
content_html:
Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) and Oklo (NYSE: OKLO) represent two different ways to invest in the soaring energy demands of the booming AI market. Bloom produces solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs), which can convert natural gas, propane, biogas, and pure hydrogen into electricity via an oxygen-driven electrochemical reaction that doesn't require any combustion. They can also be deployed rapidly, often in less than two months, and bypass conventional power grids. That cleaner, faster approach made Bloom popular with hyperscalers.

Oklo develops microreactors, which are much smaller than traditional nuclear reactors but can be linked together with additional reactors to produce more power. These modular designs are well-suited for deploying smaller nuclear power plants in remote locations, which makes them appealing to hyperscalers that want to build their data centers in off-grid areas.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Over the past two years, Bloom's stock has surged about 2,030%, and Oklo's stock has rallied more than 510%. Let's see why Bloom generated much bigger gains than Oklo -- and if it will remain the better play on the AI-driven energy boom for the foreseeable future.

The differences between Bloom and Oklo

Bloom outperformed Oklo for a simple reason: it generates billions of dollars in annual revenue and serves cloud and data center giants like Oracle, CoreWeave, Nebius, and Equinix. Oklo has neither deployed any of its Aurora microreactors nor generated any meaningful revenue yet.

From 2025 to 2028, analysts expect Bloom's revenue to grow at a 70% CAGR to $9.9 billion, while its adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) increase at a 120% CAGR to $2.9 billion. With a market cap of $69.6 billion, Bloom trades at 17 times this year's sales and 7 times its 2028 sales.

Oklo expects to deploy its first microreactors in 2027 or 2028. If that happens, analysts expect its annual revenue to surge to $55 million in 2028. But with a market cap of $8.6 billion, Oklo already trades at 156 times its 2028 sales. Its adjusted EBITDA is expected to stay negative.

Why will Bloom remain the better AI-power play?

Bloom had a great run over the past two years, but it still isn't overvalued relative to its growth potential. It dominates the SOFC market, serves major customers, and is funded by Brookfield Asset Management (NYSE: BAM), one of the world's largest asset managers.

content_html_zh:
Bloom Energy（纽约证券交易所代码：BE）和 Oklo（纽约证券交易所代码：OKLO）代表了投资蓬勃发展的人工智能市场不断飙升的能源需求的两种不同方式。 Bloom 生产固体氧化物燃料电池 (SOFC)，它可以通过氧气驱动的电化学反应将天然气、丙烷、沼气和纯氢转化为电能，无需任何燃烧。 它们还可以快速部署，通常在不到两个月的时间内，并绕过传统电网。 这种更干净、更快的方法使 Bloom 受到超大规模企业的欢迎。

奥克洛开发的微反应堆比传统核反应堆小得多，但可以与其他反应堆连接在一起以产生更多电力。 这些模块化设计非常适合在偏远地区部署小型核电站，这使得它们对想要在离网区域建立数据中心的超大规模企业具有吸引力。

过去两年，Bloom 的股价飙升约 2,030%，Oklo 的股价上涨超过 510%。 让我们看看为什么 Bloom 产生的收益比 Oklo 大得多，以及在可预见的未来，它是否仍将在人工智能驱动的能源繁荣中发挥更好的作用。

Bloom 和 Oklo 之间的区别

Bloom 的表现优于 Oklo 的原因很简单：它每年产生数十亿美元的收入，并为 Oracle、CoreWeave、Nebius 和 Equinix 等云和数据中心巨头提供服务。 Oklo 尚未部署任何 Aurora 微反应器，也没有产生任何有意义的收入。

分析师预计，从 2025 年到 2028 年，Bloom 的收入将以 70% 的复合年增长率增长至 99 亿美元，而调整后的息税折旧及摊销前利润 (EBITDA) 以 120% 的复合年增长率增长至 29 亿美元。 Bloom 的市值为 696 亿美元，其交易价格是今年销售额的 17 倍，是 2028 年销售额的 7 倍。

Oklo 预计将在 2027 年或 2028 年部署第一批微反应器。 如果这种情况发生，分析师预计 2028 年其年收入将飙升至 5500 万美元。 但 Oklo 的市值为 86 亿美元，其市价已是 2028 年销售额的 156 倍。 其调整后的 EBITDA 预计将维持负数。

为什么 Bloom 仍然是更好的人工智能游戏？

布鲁姆在过去两年中表现出色，但相对其增长潜力而言，其估值仍然没有被高估。 它在 SOFC 市场占据主导地位，为主要客户提供服务，并由全球最大的资产管理公司之一布鲁克菲尔德资产管理公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BAM）提供资金。
